Ignore every bus guide you find online

Ibiza scrapped its whole bus network on 1 April 2026. Old line numbers are dead, replaced with letters — T trunk, P beach, D Discobus, AERO airport. Every blog still lists the old ones, and so does the hotel. Everything here comes from ALSA’s 2026 timetables. Always tap a card: about 30% cheaper than cash.

Wednesday 2 September · arrival

Land, drop bags, walk to the good bar

You land at 19:25, so the sunset is gone before you clear baggage. Don't fight it.

    Clear by about 20:00.

  • 20:30

    Fifty minutes, €4 by card, every half hour.

  • 21:25

    P2 along the bay road, or €8 in a taxi. The hotel is in Cala de Bou, not the town.

  • 22:00

03
Thursday 3 September

Formentera, then Aragma

Taxi at both ends, so no timetable governs the day. Ses Illetes really does look like the photographs.

This day on the map ↗
  • 08:30

    Taxi from the rank on your street

    92 m from the door, Carrer des Caló 47. Off a rank the meter starts at €4.00, not €5.45.

  • 09:10

    Estació Marítima Eivissa–Formentera

    Not "al puerto" — there are two stations. Exact words below.

  • 10:00

    Fast ferry to La Savina

    Every 20–30 min, about 30 minutes. Check it's a fast one. Bring ID.

  • 10:30

    L3 to Ses Illetes

    Ten minutes, €10 return. First bus of the day, so an earlier ferry just means waiting.

  • 11:00

    Ses Illetes

    Walk the sandbar towards Espalmador. On foot or by bus the park fee doesn't apply — it's per vehicle.

  • 14:00

    Kiosko El Pirata

    Hippy beach bar from the early 80s. Casual food, famous cocktails.

  • 17:45

    Leave on the 17:45, not the last one

    Landing back before 21:00 saves the night taxi rate — worth about €8.

  • 20:45

    Aragma

    Greek mezze, #1 of 228 in San Antonio. Kitchen shuts 23:00, so book it.

  • 23:00

    ★ Ítaca · Soul House

    Free entry, 23:00–05:00, thirteen minutes along the front — and the right side of town for home.

TAXICala de Bou ↔ the Formentera terminal

Rank at the hotel

€4.00 to start, then €1.21/km by day and €1.47/km at night (21:00–07:00, plus all Sunday and Saturday from 15:00). Booking adds €1.45; the return carries a €2.00 port supplement. Budget €65–85 for the pair across the day.
Say this to the driver

“A la Estación Marítima de Formentera, avenida de Santa Eulària cien.” The other station, Botafoc, is a 2.5 km walk from the Formentera boats — and it's where a map search sends drivers by default.

Ítaca · Soul House
Free, 23:00–05:00 every Thursday. Beach terrace and an indoor room.
13 min · free
Ibiza Rocks Bar
Next door to Ítaca. DJs outdoors to 04:00, no door charge.
free
Soul City
R&B, hip-hop, garage. A few metres into the West End, nearest to a cab.
5 min
Villa Mercedes
Marina villa, live music, one civilised drink. To 01:00.
8 min
Two ways to lose money tonight

Café Mambo charges a per-person minimum on tables after 18:00 — a table for two starts around €160. Ítaca and Soul City are free.

Juan y Andrea on Illetes has prepaid minimums of €120–250 a head. Book its "random placement" slot instead — same food, no minimum.

The bus home stops at 23:30

Last P2 out of San Antonio is 23:30. After that it's a taxi from the Passeig de ses Fonts rank — 3 minutes from Soul City, 6 from Ítaca.

04
Friday 4 September · the anchor

Pool day, Calvin Harris, then CamelPhat

Keep the day flat. You're inside from five with no re-entry, then across the road until six.

This day on the map ↗
  • 11:00

    Pool, and nothing else

    Or Platja des Xinxó, four minutes away. Today is about arriving with legs.

  • 15:45

    Pre-drinks at the hotel

    Anything you drink here costs a quarter of what it does inside.

  • 16:00

    D3 to Playa d'en Bossa

    Starts at 16:00, takes 47 minutes, €4 by card.

  • 16:50

    Eat before you go in

    Six hours inside, no re-entry. El Cicheto is three minutes away, €20–30 — book it.

  • 17:00

    ★ Calvin Harris · Ushuaïa

    Open-air with MK supporting. Runs to 23:00 and starts in daylight. 18+, physical ID.

  • 23:05

    Zanzibar

    110 m from the gate, open to 04:30, €9–21. Hot food and a seat at non-club prices.

  • 00:30

    ★ CamelPhat · Hï

    Summer Of Love, closes 06:00. No cloakroom — one small bag between you.

  • 06:00

    D3 home

    Runs to 06:47. Then €8 for the last 3.5 km.

You may have 90 minutes, not 30 — check your ticket

Ushuaïa ends 23:00, Hï opens 23:30. But Hï sells in tiers — before midnight €35, before 1am €40–45, standard €50–55. A before-1am ticket buys you a proper sit-down in between. A before-midnight one means walking straight across.

Best restaurant within 200 m. Book for before the show.
3 min · €20–30

Same owners as Zanzibar. Burgers and strong cocktails, to 04:00.

05
Saturday 5 September · the big one

Cala Bassa, Es Virot, then Bresh

Bresh is the season closing party, and it's the best musical fit of your week.

This day on the map ↗
  • 11:30

    P5 to Cala Bassa

    About 34 minutes from the bus station. Or take the boat from the port — nicer trip.

  • 18:15

    Leave on time

    This is the one time today that matters — see below.

  • 20:00

    Es Virot, for sunset

    On the Cala de Bou front, walkable. Rice dishes are the reason to go. Sunset 20:20.

  • 23:30

    D1 Discobus to Sant Rafel

    Every 30 min from 23:30, thirteen minutes, €3. Buy your return as you board.

  • 23:45

    ★ Bresh · Amnesia Tickets ✓

    Main Room and the Terraza, whose glass roof floods with light at sunrise. Amnesia has lockers, unlike Hï.

Ask the price of the fish, out loud, before it's cooked

Fish by the kilo is the reliable way to get stung here — one documented dish came to €354. Es Virot, Can Pujol and El Gallo Viejo all serve whole fresh fish. The rice dishes sidestep it.

06
Sunday 6 September · recovery

Cala Comte, the sunset, an early night

You finished at 6am yesterday. This day costs almost nothing and asks almost nothing.

This day on the map ↗
  • 11:00

    Slowest morning of the trip

    The beach is four minutes from the door. No bus, no plan.

  • 15:00

    P4 to Cala Comte

    Thirty-five minutes. It calls at Cala de Bou on the way, so join it on the bay road.

  • 15:40

    €5 sunbeds after 15:30

    Capped at €10, halved after half three. Best water on the island. Cliff steps west to Cala Escondida for quiet.

  • 20:17

    ★ Sunset over the islands

    The horizon is broken by islets, so you get the whole show. Dusk ends about 20:43.

  • 21:45

    The last P4

    Cala de Bou 21:57. Don't miss it — a taxi from out there is €16.

  • 22:00

    Something cheap, then bed

    Es Puetó to 01:00, Cool Café to 02:00, Kitchen 62 two minutes away.

Buy the wine before you go

Spar is 100 m from the hotel, and there's no bus back between the sunset and the 21:45. A cold bottle on the rocks beats a €40 beach-club table for an identical view.

Aabrilru · CC BY-SA 4.0
07
Monday 7 September

Saladeta by boat, then the old town

The clearest water you'll see, reached the good way. Then the only genuinely ancient thing on the island.

This day on the map ↗
  • 10:30

    Boat from Passeig de ses Fonts

    Forty minutes up the coast, €9 return. The run itself is the point.

  • 11:10

    Walk round to Saladeta

    Ten to fifteen minutes on a rocky path behind the cove. No facilities at all — bring everything, wear trainers.

  • 16:45

    Back on the P7, not the boat

    Every 15 minutes until 20:50; the boat's last is 18:00.

  • 18:45

    T1 to Ibiza Town

    Every 15 min, 45 minutes. Stay on to the Port d'Eivissa stop — much shorter climb to the walls.

  • 19:55

    A drink on the steps at S'Escalinata

    Cushions straight onto the stone. The most charming half hour in town, and it's on the way.

  • 20:17

    Sunset from Baluard de Sant Bernat

    Free, and two minutes from your table.

  • 20:30

    Dinner in Plaça de Vila

    El Olivo Mio — booking currently held for Sunday and needs moving.

  • 22:30

    Carrer de la Verge

    Twenty tiny bars in a lane below the walls. The dancing happens in the street. No ticket.

BOATSan Antonio → Cala Salada, then P7 back

18:00
Go out by boat, come back on the P7 — four times cheaper, every 15 minutes, and it runs to 20:50 rather than 18:00, so the deadline can't strand you.
Move the El Olivo Mio booking

It's held for 20:30 on Sunday and the old town is now Monday. Plaça de Vila tables go, so ring early.

Two Monday traps in the old town

Teatro Pereyra is a ticketed dinner show now, not the free live-music bar every older guide describes. Malanga Café is your music but opens Friday and Saturday only.

Open instead: Bar 1805 daily 20:00–04:00, and Paradise Lost for actually dancing. Home on the D1 from the port, every 30 min to 06:30.

Leon petrosyan · CC BY-SA 4.0
08
Tuesday 8 September · last full day

Free

Nothing booked, on purpose. Four nights out by now and you fly tomorrow — decide this one over breakfast.

This day on the map ↗
Es Vedrà by catamaran
Capitán Nemo, 10:00–14:00 from the port. Underwater windows and a swim stop. Scenic sail, not a booze cruise.
needs booking
KISSTORY · O Beach
13:00–22:00, garage and old skool, walkable at both ends.
€25 before 14:00
Cala Gracioneta
Tiny cove, fifteen minutes on foot from town. Lowest-effort beach of the week.
walkable
Do nothing at all
Xinxó is four minutes away and the pool is closer. A legitimate plan.
free
If you want a dinner or a last night

Aragma and Chi Kee Wun both need a few days' notice — Chi Kee Wun takes coordinates, not a street name (38.972985, 1.309019). For one more room, Pacha has Gordo from €30, and the D1 drops you at the door.

If you do go out, Pacha over Es Paradís — shorter journey home, and it doesn't run to seven in the morning.

The last-mile problem — budget for it

The hotel is 3.5 km from the bus station and the P2 stops at 23:30, so every club night ends with an €8–10 taxi. Reckon on €40 across the week — and the station rank is far quieter at 5am than the club doors.

Save these: island-wide WhatsApp +34 971 33 33 33 · San Antonio rank +34 971 34 37 64.
